description_en: Retrieves the real-time SNAT forwarding data rankings for a NAT gateway
description_zh: 调用GetNatTopN接口，获取NAT网关的SNAT转发实时数据排名
kebab_example: aliyun nis get-nat-topn --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-gateway-id ngw-sample000 --begin-time 1638239092000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNatTopN

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the NAT gateway instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp in milliseconds for the metric query. If EndTime is not specified, the query returns data at the point in time specified by BeginTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询指标的开始毫秒时间戳。如果不指定EndTime，则查询的是BeginTime指定的时间点的情况
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp in milliseconds for the metric query. The maximum difference between BeginTime and EndTime cannot exceed 24 hours, which is 86400000 milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询指标的结束毫秒时间戳。BeginTime和EndTime的最大差距不能超过24小时，即86400000
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The metric used to rank the real-time SNAT forwarding data of the NAT gateway. Valid values:
InBps: inbound traffic. Unit: bit/s.
OutBps: outbound traffic. Unit: bit/s.
InPps: inbound packet rate. Unit: packets per second.
OutPps: outbound packet rate. Unit: packets per second.
NewSessionPerSecond: New Connections. Unit: connections per second.
ActiveSessionCount: Concurrent Connections. Unit: connections
parameters.help_zh:
对NAT网关进行SNAT转发实时数据排名的指标。取值：
InBps：入方向流量。单位：bps。
OutBps：出方向流量。单位：bps。
InPps：入方向包速率。单位：个/秒。
OutPps：出方向包速率。单位：个/秒。
NewSessionPerSecond：新建连接数。单位：个/秒。
ActiveSessionCount：并发连接数。单位：个
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return for the real-time SNAT forwarding data rankings of the NAT gateway. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 查询NAT网关的SNAT转发实时数据排名的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: topn

parameters.help_en: The IP address for which to query monitoring metrics. If the Ip parameter is specified, you do not need to specify TopN or OrderBy
parameters.help_zh: 查询指定IP地址的监控指标。当输入Ip参数时，无需输入TopN和OrderBy
parameters.name: ip

IsTopNOpen.description_en:
Indicates whether the Network Intelligence Service (NIS) feature is enabled. If the feature is not enabled, NatGatewayTopN returns empty.
true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
IsTopNOpen.description_zh:
是否已开通网络智能服务(NIS)功能，未开通时NatGatewayTopN返回空。
true：已开通。
false：未开通

NatGatewayTopN.description_en: The array of real-time SNAT forwarding data rankings for the NAT gateway
NatGatewayTopN.description_zh: NAT网关SNAT转发实时数据排名数组

items.description_en: The real-time SNAT forwarding data ranking object for the NAT gateway. The following metrics are averaged from BeginTime to EndTime
items.description_zh: NAT网关SNAT转发实时数据排名对象。以下指标取BeginTime到EndTime的均值

InFlowPerMinute.description_en: A reserved field. Not currently in use

InPps.description_en: The inbound packet rate. Unit: packets per second
InPps.description_zh: 入方向包速率。单位：个/秒

NewSessionPerSecond.description_en: The number of New Connections. Unit: connections per second

OutFlowPerMinute.description_en: A reserved field. Not currently in use

OutPps.description_en: The outbound packet rate. Unit: packets per second
OutPps.description_zh: 出方向包速率。单位：个/秒
